name: strata-v100-batchmtp-lookup-coder
description: Batch-MTP and prompt-lookup drafts for Coder IQ1_M on one V100-32G at 16k/64k, C1 and C4.

estimate.basis: three launches plus 4 cells per variant at 16k/64k

caveats: NEW DEFINITION, first run 2026-10-27. `batchmtp` is STRATA_BATCH_MTP=1 with --parallel 4 (C1+C4), not `--batch-groups`.
`lookup4` is --set lookup-chain=4 (prompt-lookup drafts after MTP); acceptance must be read from the engine request metrics, not assumed.
Coder IQ1_M on one V100 is effectively resident (100% decode expert hit in the 2026-10-26 sweep), which keeps the draft effect attributable.
The 16k C4 cell is unstable across variants (2026-10-26 finding); do not attribute from it alone.
